purpose: Measure the run-to-run variability of the Task 3 pipeline under identical settings. Experiment 74 and 77 used the same base configuration but produced fold-4 OCF 16.126 and 15.889 for mice1, so single-run differences of that size cannot be interpreted without a noise floor.

protocol.fold: leave-one-presentation-ordinal-out k=4 only (the fold used for OCF reporting)
protocol.model: 50 ms MLP, hidden 1024, dropout 0, seed 42, 10 epochs, identical code path to experiments 74/77 base
metrics: fold-4 OCF on RNG123 heldout pictures [256:768]
protocol.control: for repeat 1 the official OCF is computed twice on the same logits to separate scoring determinism from training nondeterminism

report: mean, standard deviation, max-min range per mouse
implied minimum detectable effect for future single-run comparisons
no_rule: this is a measurement experiment; no candidate is adopted
